subject: accounting
summary: Accounting is the most readable of these subjects: questions are typed as clean text at full size and the scheme is a tick-list of figures with their marks, which works equally well on phone and desktop. Where the scheme is a set of figures (cash-flow reconciliation, statement of capital, marginal costing statement) it is clear and plainly answers the question. Where the scheme is a calculation or a written explanation it falls apart: the whole answer is poured into one run-on box labelled 'BLOCK' or 'SECTION TOTAL', cut off mid-word, or reduced to a bare label such as '(a) (i) Purchases' with no figure. Every card prints a raw code '\u2019' in the line under the scheme heading. The figures the question depends on are never on the card, only in an attached page, which in one case opens on a completely different question.

issues.title: Raw escape code printed on every card
issues.detail: The line under the scheme heading reads 'The scheme\u2019s own lines with their marks, as printed' on all twelve cards, phone and desktop. The apostrophe is shown as the literal characters \u2019.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix the string so it prints 'The scheme's own lines'.

issues.title: Written and calculation answers flattened into one run-on box
issues.detail: Card 1 pours a five-line calculation into a single paragraph with slashes ('Cost of sales / Average stock = 8 times. Average stock × 8 = 536,000. Average stock = 536,000 / 8 = 67,000. Average stock = (? + 75,000) / 2 = 67,000. Opening stock = €59,000'). Card 2 runs the list of books together with no separators ('Sales Sales Returns General Journal Cash Book – Receipts and Payments (ii) They act as a check...'). Card 10 strings bullet points together with '•' inline. Card 4 joins two reasons with a slash and no full stop ('Failure to complete the double entry/ Errors in the ledgers Incorrect totalling...'). One tick box covers the whole 8 or 12 marks, so partial credit cannot be claimed.
issues.suggested_fix: Break the scheme into one line per step or point with its own marks, as the figure-based cards do. For calculations show formula, substitution and answer on separate lines; a crop of the official scheme would be clearer than this text.

issues.title: Scheme text cut off or starting mid-sentence
issues.detail: Card 2 ends '...credit sales or credit purchases from inco'. Card 10 ends '...creditor control accounts are used to' and never answers the second half of the question (how a contra entry may arise). Card 5 begins mid-sentence: 'at a later date. In this question trade creditors are €93,000.' with the definition missing. Card 11's two lines start 'therefore the variable cost per unit is €6.80' and 'Therefore, fixed cost 6,000' with the working missing.
issues.suggested_fix: Store and show the full scheme text for the part, including every sub-part; never truncate. Show the high-low working for card 11.

issues.title: Scheme line has no answer in it
issues.detail: Card 6 shows a single line '(a) (i) Purchases' worth 10 marks with no figure or working. Card 9 shows only the formula 'Margin of Safety = Budgeted Sales - Break Even Sales' with neither the units nor the euro answer. Card 8's last line is 'Capital' with no total. Card 12's first line reads 'Sales (46,200 units) × 877,800', where the unit price has been lost so it reads as a multiplication by the total.
issues.suggested_fix: Every scheme line must carry its figure. Show Purchases with its working, the two margin-of-safety answers, the capital total, and 'Sales (46,200 units × €19) 877,800'.

issues.title: Question data is not on the card
issues.detail: Every calculation card depends on a table or list of figures that is only in the attached pages. Card 5 says 'how they apply to the above accounts' with nothing above. Card 1, 6, 9 and 12 cannot be attempted without opening the pages. This is the standard design here, but it means the card on its own is never a complete question.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the relevant table (or a crop of it) inline beneath the question, collapsed on phone if long.

issues.title: Attached page shows a different question
issues.detail: Card 4 (2010 HL Q4(c), control accounts) opens on the whole of Q3 'Depreciation of Fixed Assets' with its parts (a)-(d); Q4 is not visible on the first view. Other cards open on the correct question but show the whole question with all sibling parts (cards 9, 11, 12 list parts (a) onwards). Theory cards 2 and 10 attach a full page of ledger adjustments labelled 'Figures, tables and instructions' that the theory part does not need.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop or scroll the attached page to this question. Drop the data attachment on pure theory parts, or label it as background.

issues.title: Ledger layout lost
issues.detail: Card 3 asks for a control account but the scheme is a flat list with no debit or credit side, so 'Balance b/d 280' and 'Balance b/d 48,760' look like duplicates, and the last line shows stray underscores: '____ Balance c/d 280'. The closing credit balance is not shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Group lines under Debit and Credit headings (or show the official T-account crop) and remove the underscore run.

issues.title: Jargon labels and wording
issues.detail: Boxes are labelled 'BLOCK' and 'SECTION TOTAL', which mean nothing to a student. The heading 'Claim each figure the scheme prices.' is awkward and is used even on theory answers with no figures. The footer reads 'No Accounting allocation placement selected yet'. The button label is truncated on the phone: 'Worked solution and mark allocat…'. An empty band of about 200px sits under the attachment button on the phone.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the internal labels, reword to 'Tick each line you got', shorten the button label so it fits, and reword the footer.

good_examples.why: Six clear scheme lines, each with its figure and marks, adding to 30; reads the same on phone and desktop
Clean typed question and a line-by-line statement of capital with marks per figure
